question: Is the stop structural or a fixed number?

options.text: Structural/two-stage: below the OB low, then raised to below 50% of the OB range.
options.quote: just below the 50 percent of the order block total range is also considered to be a good location to raise the stop loss

options.text: Trailed below the lowest low of the last 40 trading days (position trades).
options.quote: you're going to be trailing your stop loss below the lowest low in the last 40 trading days

options.text: Fixed: a static four-point stop on every trade, regardless of structure.
options.quote: we'll trade with a hard stop of Four Points this is a static stop loss for all trades

options.text: Inside an already-rebalanced range, below 75% of the range is called comfortable.
options.quote: 75 of that range if my stop is below that I'm comfortable with that

independence: All four are the same speaker in different lectures/years; NOT_INDEPENDENT, and none is a correction of another.

question: What are the operative time windows, and in which time zone?

options.text: ICT New York killzone starts 07:00 New York time.
options.quote: what is seven o'clock in the morning new york time that's the beginning of my ict new york kill zone

options.text: It extends to 10:00 in the morning (qualifier ASR 'when it's 4x').
options.quote: it's extended to 10 o'clock in the morning when it's 4x

options.text: Operating session AM 09:30-11:30 New York local time.
options.quote: the am session is 9 30 a.m to 11 30 a.m New York local time

options.text: Operating session PM 13:30-15:30 New York local time.
options.quote: the PM session is 1 30 P.M to 3 30 PM New York local time

independence: Same speaker; the 07:00-10:00 killzone and the 09:30-11:30 operating session are different objects (killzone vs trading window), which is why they are not merged.

question: Limit at the array or stop-entry after the shift?

options.text: The choice is left to the trader - either is acceptable.
options.quote: you're going to have to determine whether you're going to be a buyer on a stop or a buyer on a limit

options.text: Limits may miss fills because they demand a price; stop entries fill more often but widen the entry-to-stop gap.
options.quote: there's a probability of you missing moves or missing your fills because you're demanding a specific price level

options.text: The FVG is selected so that the fixed four-point stop is possible - i.e. selection, not order type, carries the risk decision.
options.quote: you're selecting a fair value Gap that permits a four point stop loss

independence: Same speaker, same two lectures; NOT_INDEPENDENT.

question: Which lower timeframe is used for the shift and the entry?

options.text: Whichever timeframe actually produces the fair value gaps.
options.quote: we're looking for a time frame that produces fair value gaps that's the key

options.text: The stated stack is four hours down to five minutes.
options.quote: ICT short-term top-down analysis four hours to five minutes

options.text: For the setup he hunts on the five minute 'or lower', then refines to 4/3/2/1 minute.
options.quote: whatever time frame you're hunting whether it be the five minute or lower

options.text: The four-hour chart is pulled out 'when it's necessary'.
options.quote: I'm gonna pull out the four hour chart when it's necessary

independence: Same speaker across three lectures; NOT_INDEPENDENT. Recorded because a deterministic engine needs one rule and the corpus gives four.
